MFG serves as a dynamic platform facilitating seamless connections between buyers seeking custom parts and manufacturers specializing in custom part production.
MFG has three key components that assist buyers and manufacturers in finding and working with each other efficiently:

is a listing of global manufacturers. Buyers can search and browse profiles, then reach out to those they believe best fit their needs. Manufacturers can be discovered based on capabilities, certifications, and location.
